reply:
Context: a Graph is a set of Nodes and paths that controls a task. A Node is one step in the Graph. A Checkpoint is a saved record of the Graph state that can help it continue.

The Graph stops at a point where it waits for a confirmation. A Checkpoint is saved at this point. The Checkpoint links the reply to the execution that is now suspended. After the Graph continues, the downstream Node makes the report.

This does not guarantee that the external file write happens only once. If the system crashes, the file write can happen again.
